subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw accept showing the existing admin-scoped configPath in the Overview snapshot card, move it to Config/Settings, or keep this information CLI-only?
rationale: The technical patch is narrow, but the visible placement and absolute-path exposure are UX/product choices that proof alone cannot decide.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land the presentation-only row after proof and rebase confirm it displays the existing admin-scoped snapshot field correctly.

options.title: Move To Config
options.body: Ask for the same field to be surfaced in the Config or Settings area instead of the Overview card.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline the additional UI exposure point and rely on existing config path CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land the presentation-only row after proof and rebase confirm it displays the existing admin-scoped snapshot field correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent UI and protocol work plus project-level product context make this the best available routing candidate.
